name: Husqvarna 115iPT4
blurb: Battery pole saw. 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, chain H37, from the 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 115iPT4 is listed as a residential battery pole saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) pairs a 10″ laminate bar 596298540 with chain H37 591106040: 3/8″ Mini, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, 5/32″ file. The 120iTK4-P uses the same chain and a different bar part.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 10″ setup with bar Laminate 596298540 and chain H37 591106040.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover year 2027: certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw
